newsitem.title: USA: Detroit robbery erupts into gunfire, killing two.
newsitem.headline: Detroit robbery erupts into gunfire, killing two.

text.p: Two people, including a hostage, were killed and four others injured when a gun battle broke out Tuesday behind a bank after an attempted robbery.

Witnesses told local television and radio stations that numerous shots were fired at a Comerica Bank branch on Detroit's East Side after an individual dressed in camouflage entered the bank carrying an automatic weapon.
The gunman and a hostage he apparently took were killed in an exchange of gunfire with police in an alley behind the bank, witnesses said.
"He grabbed the guy around the neck, and put the gun to his head and the police just started loading up on him," a tow truck driver who witnessed the incident told WWJ Radio.
At least one injured person was taken to St. John Hospital and Medical Centre in Detroit, a hospital spokeswoman said.
Police were alerted to the incident and surrounded the bank while the gunman was still inside the building.
Comerica spokeswoman Kathy Pitton would only confirm that a robbery attempt at the bank branch had led to a hostage situation.
